messages:
Evan Liu: hey team, quick onboarding snag. I can see most Grafana folders but the embedded panels in the docs iframe show "panel not found". Clicking the panel opens fine directly but embeds 403s. anyone seen this?
Nina (devex): hey evan, welcome! :wave: can you paste the embed url and the page youre opening it from? is this the Confluence playbook or our internal handbook?
Evan Liu: from the playbook page under /playbooks/observability/alerts. embed url looks like: https://grafana.redwood.example/d-solo/xyz123/prod-dashboard?orgId=1&panelId=5. Page is internal Confluence (team space).
Gabe (obs-eng): usually embeddeds 403 when Grafana anonymous access for that folder is off or the embed token expired. We used short-lived signed embeds for the handbook. What error do you see in the console?
Evan Liu: console shows: "GET /render/d-solo/xyz123/prod-dashboard?panelId=5 403". Also the handbook iframe has a small lock icon and Confluence warns mixed content sometimes.
Nina (devex): ok two things to check: 1) are you accessing Confluence via the corporate VPN or SSO? 2) do you have the "redwood-observability-embeders" group?
Evan Liu: on VPN; SSO OK. I don't see that group in my profile.
DevEx Bot: Created ticket #DX-3299 - "Embed access: add evan@redwood.ai to redwood-observability-embeders and verify embed token rotation". Assignee: Nina. ETA: 4 hours.
Gabe (obs-eng): Ill also check grafana's embed token logs. Quick workaround: open the dashboard directly and click the panel menu > share > direct link to panel. That bypasses the iframe.
Evan Liu: thanks — that works. Two more small Qs: 1) Datadog monitors: I set up my API key as `export DD_API_KEY=...` but `datadog monitors list` returns empty. Is there an org-level role I need? 2) Sentry: when I try to create a report it says "project access required".
Nina (devex): for Datadog the api key alone isn't enough; you need an application key tied to your username for read/write CLI operations. File a subtask on #DX-3299 and we can generate an app key or add you to the `observability-cli` role. For Sentry we'll need the project slugs.
Gabe (obs-eng): Evan, send me the project slugs (or I can map from your repo permissions). For Datadog, try `datadog api-key list` and `datadog app-key create --name evan-cli` (we can create it for you if you lack perms).
Evan Liu: repo is github.com/redwood/frontend, projects `frontend-web`, `alerts-engine`. also I attempted `datadog app-key create` and got "Forbidden".
Nina (devex): noted. I'll add the app-key creation to #DX-3299. Gabe, can you scope Sentry project access for `frontend-web` + `alerts-engine`?
Gabe (obs-eng): done, I added a note and will add him to the Sentry frontend team. Expect Sentry in ~2h and Datadog app key by EOD after infra approves.
Evan Liu: perfect, thanks both. Appreciate the fast help!
Nina (devex): welcome aboard again — ping here if anything else blocks your runbook walkthrough. Closing updates will be posted to #DX-3299. :thumbsup:
